title: 微型蜂巢搬运车
prompt:
题材为“微型蜂巢搬运车”。本例使用已收集的公开提示词结构，独立设计新主体与场景。用机器人和与其功能直接相关的工作单元组成场景，关节和任务对象有明确空间关系。 请明确表现该主体区别于相近题材的至少四项几何特征，并用少量相关细节丰富叙事。不同案例须有自己的轮廓、空间组织与主要结构。以暖木色、炭灰和柔黄铜为主，靠形体和层次区分材质。 保持所有角度的完整体积，避免大块空底座与平面贴片，不添加文字、品牌标识、真实人名、账号或内部路径。 动画：安排可见的关节摆动、游动或飞行动作，身体与肢体的运动协调且保持连接。 使用真实部件运动和可观察的相对运动，围绕实际轴心或关节运动，完整循环中结构连接稳定且无明显穿模。
多物件构图要求：这是包含 4 个主要物件的场景。必须完整呈现：微型蜂巢搬运车、球形巡检机器人、工具立柜、待装配舱体。每件应有可辨的完整形状、功能结构和足够体量，四个视角合起来能认出全部目标。采用前后两层的工作组合，较小物件靠近前景，主要对象互相呼应。围绕原主题选择合理的共同使用情境，统一比例和材质，形成组合陈列、协作、供给或生态活动关系。 地面、底座和零散装饰不计入主要物件数量。 多物件动画：至少让“微型蜂巢搬运车”与“球形巡检机器人”各自表现独立、可见的功能部件运动或符合习性的动作；用不同节奏或先后次序建立相互关系，稳定基座和栖地保持固定，各对象运动范围互不冲突。
shared_prompt:
You are the current coding model creating a collection of beautiful real 3D voxel dioramas. For each assigned scene produce an original executable JavaScript program. Make each composition distinct in silhouette, spatial layout, materials, focal object and secondary details. Build complete volumes that remain convincing when rotated. Do not use a stock scene generator or repeated semantic templates.

The program runs in an isolated VM on a 256 x 256 x 256 grid. Integer x,y,z coordinates are 0..255. Y is up, +Z is front. Keep all occupied cells within x,z=10..245 and y=4..245. Compose within about 160..210 cells of width/depth. Aim for 60,000..700,000 occupied voxels and no more than 1,500,000. No clipping, invalid coordinates, enormous bases, or detached accidental pieces. All visible details must be true voxels.

Available generic geometry primitives:
block(x,y,z,color): one integer voxel; color '#RRGGBB'; null erases.
box(x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,color): inclusive filled box, all corner coordinates integers, either order accepted.
line(x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,color): thin line, rounds sample positions.
ellipsoid(cx,cy,cz,rx,ry,rz,color): filled ellipsoid; radii strictly positive; floats allowed.
cylinder(cx,y0,cz,radius,height,color): filled vertical cylinder starting at y0.
cone(cx,y0,cz,bottomRadius,topRadius,height,color): vertical truncated cone; radius can reach zero at an end.
beam(x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1,radius,color): filled round beam/capsule between endpoints, floats allowed.
ring(cx,cy,cz,majorRadius,tubeRadius,color,axis='y'): filled torus, axis is the normal of its ring plane.
rng(): seeded deterministic random number [0,1).
Math, arrays, objects, loops and local functions are available. No other globals. No imports, require, DOM, network, filesystem, process, eval, external assets or async. Do not redefine the primitives. Box coordinates MUST be rounded if computed from trigonometry or division. Helpers that operate on continuous geometry accept floats and rasterize to integer voxels.

Use a limited, harmonious, purposeful palette (roughly 12..40 colors), sophisticated silhouettes, detailed structural elements, readable focal subjects, careful negative space, integrated secondary objects and clean material differentiation. Prefer layered architectural shapes, rounded/tapered organic shapes, and details with a clear purpose. A base may unify a diorama but should not dominate it. Avoid sparse generic boxes, random confetti, flat cutouts, featureless slabs and oversized empty ground. No text, logos, company names, personal names, handles or trademarks anywhere in the program, comments or geometry. Avoid unnecessary prose in code comments.

Do not investigate the workspace or read unrelated files. The entire scene brief and API are supplied here. Output the requested JSON schema with one entry per assigned scene; each code value contains complete executable JavaScript with top-level construction calls. Do not just define an uncalled build function. Do not output a fabricated render/quality score. The caller will execute and render your actual code and return failures for repair.

Use only the supplied seeded rng() for randomness. Do not use Math.random(), Date or time-dependent geometry. The saved scene code must reproduce the same voxel model on rerun.

JavaScript syntax: unary minus may not be used immediately before exponentiation. For a negative square use -(u*u), -Math.pow(u,2), or -(u**2). For a Gaussian use Math.exp(-(u*u)); never emit Math.exp(-u**2) or Math.exp(-((x-c)/r)**2).



ANIMATED SCENES: Return complete rest-pose voxel scene code AND a matching motion object for each scene. The model is rendered as rigid voxel components: objects move, the camera does not need to move. Do not change or import the runtime.

Motion schema: version=1; duration in seconds (use 12 unless the scene benefits from 6); description; parts array. Each part has a unique ASCII id, parent=null or another part id, box=[xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax] INCLUSIVE integer rest-pose coordinates, colors=[#RRGGBB strings], channels=[...]. A voxel matches a part only when it lies inside its box AND its color is one of those colors (empty colors selects all colors). No two part selections may overlap. Every part must contain real voxels from your code. Use DISTINCT subtle colors for moving parts when a bounding box contains other objects. Static voxels outside all part selections stay fixed. Parent chains transform children too, all construction coordinates and pivots are expressed in the original common coordinate system. No parent cycles.

Each channel has type, axis ('x','y','z'), pivot=[x,y,z], amount, period, phase (a number in radians).
- spin: rotates about axis through pivot by amount*t/period. Use amount=6.283185307179586 or its negative for a complete turn.
- swing: rotates about pivot by amount*(sin(2*pi*t/period+phase)-sin(phase)). amount is radians.
- bob: translates along axis by amount*(sin(2*pi*t/period+phase)-sin(phase)). amount is grid units.
- flow: translates along axis by amount*((t/period)%1), then resets. Only use for flowing particles whose reset is intentionally hidden inside a spout, chute or other object.
All periods must divide duration exactly (for 12 seconds use 1,2,3,4,6,12). At time 0 all transforms are identity, matching the static .vox download. For a hinged part that should swing only in a positive range, set phase=-1.5707963267948966; then the displacement factor is 1-cos(t). Keep motions modest and physically connected: hinges stay attached, wheels rotate about axles, supporting beams remain fixed. Do not create a disassembled explosion unless the brief explicitly asks for it.

Design a complete, distinct, source-related composition with 2–14 animated pieces where appropriate. All moving objects must remain in a comfortable view and avoid the static geometry during their full cycle. Never animate the entire scene as the only motion. Add no company names, real person names, source handles, logos or identifying text. Keep comments neutral. Output JSON only through the schema.

KEYFRAMES, when choreography needs ordered actions: each channel also includes keys (use [] for ordinary spin/swing/bob/flow). Type move_keys translates along axis; turn_keys rotates around pivot and axis. keys is [[seconds,value], ...], strictly increasing, starts [0,0], ends [duration,0], maximum 32 pairs. Values are grid-unit offsets for move_keys or radians for turn_keys; multiplied by amount (normally 1). Interpolation is smoothstep between pairs. Set period=duration, phase=0. Use this to coordinate an actual sequence such as a football player advancing, kicking, ball flight, goalkeeper action and return to start. Parent motion propagates to child limbs; keep pivots in the original rest-pose world coordinates. Avoid discontinuous resets visible in open space.


Produce the scene programs directly. Tools are disabled for this generation call. The caller executes and visually checks your code after you return it; do not claim you ran tests.
